Environment that accelerates compiling an R package

Source: R/accel.R
accel_env.Rd

Environment that accelerates compiling an R package

Usage

accel_env(
  cache_dir,
  jobs = parallel::detectCores(),
  profile = c("faithful", "fast"),
  ccache = TRUE,
  sccache = TRUE
)

Arguments

cache_dir

Directory holding the persistent caches (ccache, sccache). Persist it between CI runs (e.g. with `actions/cache`).

jobs

Number of parallel compile jobs.

profile

`"faithful"` keeps R's compiler flags untouched (results match a plain `R CMD check`). `"fast"` additionally compiles C/C++ with `-O0 -g0` and Rust without LTO at `opt-level=1`; much faster for heavy C++/Rust code but may hide optimisation-dependent compiler warnings.

ccache, sccache

Use the compiler cache if it is on the `PATH`.

Value

Named character vector of environment variables.
